question: In relation to the presence of mutations in EFGR in patients with non-small cell lung cancer, which of the following statements is FALSE?

options.opa: They are especially frequent in Caucasian patients and exceptional in Asian population.
options.opb: They are located mainly in exons 19 and 21 of the gene.
options.opc: They are more frequent in adenocarcinomas, in non-smokers and in females.
options.opd: In patients with advanced stages, the use of tyrosine kinase inhibitors (gefitinib or erlotinib) has been shown to be superior to chemotherapy.
